html:
In June 1798 Napoleon, on his way to invade Egypt, seized Malta from the Knights with almost no fight. French rule lasted two years.

The French abolished the nobility and the Inquisition and took church silver to pay for the war. Within months the Maltese rose up, and with help from Britain, Portugal and Naples they besieged the French garrison in Valletta. Hunger forced its surrender in September 1800.

The Maltese then asked for British protection. The Treaty of Paris of 1814 made Malta a British colony. Its harbours became a key naval base of the British Empire on the route to India, all the more after the Suez Canal opened in 1869.
sum: In June 1798 Napoleon, on his way to invade Egypt, seized Malta from the Knights with almost no fight. French rule lasted two years.
